definitions.explanation: The name given to a book, movie, article, song, or other creative work.

examples.english: What is the title of this book?

examples.japanese: {題名|だいめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{想像|そうぞう}→想像：02489_souzou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I imagined the content based on the title.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{題名|だいめい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}せない→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: I can't remember the title of the movie.

examples.japanese: {題名|だいめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Giving it a title is the hardest part.

examples.japanese: {題名|だいめい}⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦よう→よう：01114_you⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}きたい→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I want to write a book that draws interest just from its title.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {題名|だいめい}: Title of a creative work (book, movie, song)
- ⟦タイトル→タイトル：03855_taitoru⟧: Title (loanword, widely used)
- ⟦{題|だい}→題：noentry⟧: Title, topic, subject (broader meaning)
- ⟦{件名|けんめい}→件名：11552_kenmei⟧: Subject line (email)
- ⟦{表題|ひょうだい}→表題：14099_hyoudai⟧: Title, heading (more formal)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {題名|だいめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to give a title)
- {題名|だいめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (to think of a title)
- {題名|だいめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (untitled work)
